backburner.header.title: Backlog
backburner.config.anchorX.tooltip:
Which side of the screen the HUD will be anchored to.
The text will keep aligning to the left regardless of this setting, so anchoring to the right may not look good with all themes.
0: left
1: right
backburner.config.commandRoot.descriptio: Changes to the root won't take effect until you restart the game!
backburner.config.commandRoot.tooltip: Changes the command used to interact with the backlog. Useful in case its name conflicts with another mod
backburner.config.hudWidth.tooltip: Controls how much text the HUD can holds before wrapping.
backburner.config.hudX.tooltip: The horizontal position, relative to the side of the screen closest to the anchor.
backburner.config.hudY.tooltip: The vertical position, relative to the top of the screen.
backburner.config.hudScale.tooltip: Scales the backlog's GUI Scale in relation to the vanilla HUD
backburner.config.hudScale.fractional.to:
When disabled, the effective GUI Scale will be snapped to the closest integer.
Fractional scales may not look good without other mods such as "Advanced UI Scale"
